# Aim

Select the environmental predictors used in scripts 4 (dbRDA, Hill numbers), 6 (GLLVM) and 7 (FAPROTAX):

1. Pairwise correlations among the measured variables (Figure S6).
2. Removal of variables with |r| > `cor_cutoff` (caret `findCorrelation`).
3. Variance inflation factors of the remaining variables; variables with VIF ≥ `vif_threshold` are removed (usdm `vifstep`).
4. Checks of the site values in the metadata (DIN, coordinates, depth).
5. Table 1: environmental variables per site.

Reef mats only, after filtering (`data/bcms_filtered_raja2023.rds`, script 2). The environmental values were measured per site, so all mats of a site have the same values. Each script standardises the selected predictors itself, within the reef mats it uses.

Outputs: `figures/3.environmental_correlations/F<n>_<name>.pdf` and `outputs/3.environmental_correlations/T<n>_<name>.docx` (+ `.csv`).

packages_used <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "phyloseq", "corrplot", "caret", "usdm",

## Settings

```{r settings}
counts_file <- "data/bcms_filtered_raja2023.rds"   # reef mats after filtering (script 2)

# Candidate predictors (column names in the metadata)
env_candidates <- c("temperature", "salinity", "chla", "mean.PO4", "DIN")
var_labels <- c(temperature = "Temperature", salinity = "Salinity", chla = "Chl-a",
                mean.PO4 = "PO4", DIN = "DIN")

cor_cutoff    <- 0.75   # remove one of each pair with |r| above this
vif_threshold <- 5      # remove variables with VIF >= this

# ---- Table 1 (section 5) ----
# Metadata columns -> Table 1 columns and decimals
table1_vars <- tribble(
  ~variable, ~column,        ~label,                   ~digits,
  "temperature", "temperature",  "Temperature (°C)",     1,
  "salinity",    "salinity",     "Salinity (PSU)",       1,
  "chla",        "chla",         "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)", 1,
  "PO4",         "mean.PO4",     "PO₄³⁻ (µmol/L)",       2,
  "NO3NO2",      "mean.NO3.NO2", "NO₂⁻ + NO₃⁻ (µmol/L)", 1,
  "NH4",         "mean.NH4",     "NH₄⁺ (µmol/L)",        1,
  "DIN",         "DIN",          "DIN (µmol/L)",         1)
din_tolerance <- 0.02   # DIN check: relative difference from NH4 + NO2 + NO3 that is flagged

# Raw measurements for Table 1 (mean and range per site)
nutrient_file <- "data/DIN_mtm_raw.csv"          # one row per water sample (NIOZ)
ctd_file      <- "data/env_ctd_20232024.csv"     # one row per CTD reading
ctd_depth     <- c(1, 5)                         # depth interval (m), as in Methods 2.5
# Site names in the raw files -> site codes in the metadata
raw_site_map  <- c("NewReef" = "New Reef")

order_sitetype <- c("MiosKon", "LumbaLumba", "SouthKri", "Arborek",
                    "Yenbuba", "New Reef", "SoridoBay", "GracesWall")
site_labels <- c("MiosKon" = "MiosKon", "LumbaLumba" = "Lumba-Lumba", "SouthKri" = "SouthKri",
                 "Arborek" = "Arborek", "Yenbuba" = "Yenbuba", "New Reef" = "New Reef",
                 "SoridoBay" = "Sorido Bay", "GracesWall" = "Grace's Wall")

# Correlation plot colours
color_cor <- c("#7F3B08", "#B75B04", "#E68D25", "#FDC57E", "#FEEDD6",
               "#E9EAF3", "#BEBADA", "#8B7FB4", "#582F8C", "#3B1559")
```

## Output helpers

```{r output helpers}
save_tab <- function(table, name) {
  doc <- read_docx() %>% body_add_flextable(autofit(flextable(table)))
  print(doc, target = file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".docx")))
  write.csv(table, file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

# Draw a base-graphics plot on screen and save it as PDF
save_base_fig <- function(name, draw, width = 8, height = 8) {
  draw()
  cairo_pdf(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height)
  draw()
  dev.off()
  invisible()
}
```

#--------------------------

# 1. Data

```{r data}
reefs <- readRDS(counts_file)
env <- as(sample_data(reefs), "data.frame") %>% filter(!is.na(site))
stopifnot(all(env_candidates %in% colnames(env)), !anyNA(env[env_candidates]))
message(nrow(env), " mats, ", n_distinct(env$site), " sites")

env_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(env[, env_candidates]))
colnames(env_scaled) <- var_labels[colnames(env_scaled)]
```

# 2. Correlations

```{r correlations}
cor_matrix <- cor(env_scaled)
cor_test   <- cor.mtest(env_scaled, conf.level = 0.95)

save_base_fig("F1_correlations_environment", function()
  corrplot(cor_matrix,
           method = "circle", type = "lower", order = "alphabet",
           p.mat = cor_test$p, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "p-value",
           col = colorRampPalette(color_cor)(10),
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, tl.cex = 0.9,
           cl.pos = "b", cl.ratio = 0.2, addgrid.col = "grey",
           mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1), diag = FALSE))

cor_table <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  setNames(c("Variable 1", "Variable 2", "r")) %>%
  mutate(p = as.vector(cor_test$p)) %>%
  filter(match(`Variable 1`, colnames(cor_matrix)) < match(`Variable 2`, colnames(cor_matrix))) %>%
  mutate(r = round(r, 2), p = signif(p, 3))
cor_table
save_tab(cor_table, "T1_correlations_environment")
```

# 3. Predictor selection

```{r predictor selection}
# 1) Pairwise correlations above the cutoff
remove_cor <- colnames(env_scaled)[findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = cor_cutoff)]
message("Removed, |r| > ", cor_cutoff, ": ", if (length(remove_cor)) paste(remove_cor, collapse = ", ") else "none")
env_kept <- env_scaled[, setdiff(colnames(env_scaled), remove_cor), drop = FALSE]

# 2) Variance inflation factors
vif_all  <- vif(env_kept)   # usdm
vif_step <- vifstep(env_kept, th = vif_threshold)
vif_step
remove_vif <- vif_step@excluded
message("Removed, VIF >= ", vif_threshold, ": ", if (length(remove_vif)) paste(remove_vif, collapse = ", ") else "none")

predictors <- setdiff(colnames(env_kept), remove_vif)
message("Predictors used in scripts 4, 6 and 7: ", paste(predictors, collapse = ", "))

vif_table <- vif_all %>%
  rename(`VIF (all variables)` = VIF) %>%
  left_join(vif_step@results %>% rename(`VIF (selected)` = VIF), by = "Variables") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         Selected = Variables %in% predictors)
vif_table
save_tab(vif_table, "T2_vif")

# Scripts 4, 6 and 7 use DIN, PO4, temperature and chl-a; warn if the selection is different
if (!setequal(predictors, c("DIN", "PO4", "Temperature", "Chl-a")))
  warning("The selected predictors differ from those used in scripts 4, 6 and 7: update those scripts")
```

# 4. Checks of the site values

The environmental variables were measured per site, so every mat of a site should have the same values, and DIN should equal NH₄⁺ + NO₂⁻ + NO₃⁻.

```{r site checks}
# One value per site (also coordinates and depth)
check_vars <- c(table1_vars$column, "mean.NO2", "mean.NO3", "depth", "lat", "lon")
check_vars <- intersect(check_vars, colnames(env))
n_values <- env %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(check_vars), ~ n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-site, names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_values") %>%
  filter(n_values > 1)
n_values   # variables with more than one value within a site

# Mats whose coordinates or depth differ from the rest of their site
mode_val <- function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
odd_mats <- env %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(lat_site = as.numeric(mode_val(lat)), lon_site = as.numeric(mode_val(lon)),
         depth_site = mode_val(depth)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(lat != lat_site | lon != lon_site | as.character(depth) != depth_site) %>%
  select(sample_id, site, lat, lon, lat_site, lon_site, depth, depth_site)
odd_mats
message("Sampling depth per site (m): ",
        paste(distinct(env, site, depth)$site, distinct(env, site, depth)$depth, sep = " = ", collapse = "; "))

# DIN = NH4 + NO2 + NO3
din_check <- env %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(across(c(DIN, mean.NH4, mean.NO3.NO2), first), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(NH4_plus_NO3NO2 = mean.NH4 + mean.NO3.NO2,
         rel_diff = abs(DIN - NH4_plus_NO3NO2) / NH4_plus_NO3NO2,
         DIN_differs = rel_diff > din_tolerance) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
din_check
if (any(din_check$DIN_differs))
  warning("DIN differs from NH4 + NO2 + NO3 at: ", paste(din_check$site[din_check$DIN_differs], collapse = ", "),
          ". These DIN values are used in scripts 3-7.")

save_tab(din_check, "T4_check_DIN")
save_tab(odd_mats,  "T5_check_coordinates_depth")
```

# 5. Table 1: environmental variables per site

Each cell is "site value (min–max)":

- Site value: the value in the metadata, i.e. the value used in all models. For nutrients these exclude some high NH₄⁺/DIN samples (IQR rule in din_exploratory.Rmd), so they can differ from the mean of all samples.
- Range: min and max of all raw measurements of the site.
  - Temperature, salinity and chl-a: all CTD readings between `ctd_depth` m.
  - PO₄³⁻, NO₂⁻ + NO₃⁻, NH₄⁺: all water samples of the site (both replicates, all depths); DIN per sample = NH₄⁺ + NO₂⁻ + NO₃⁻.

Sites are ordered by increasing DIN (metadata value). T6 lists where the metadata value differs from the mean of all raw samples.

```{r table 1}
fmt <- function(x, d) sprintf("%.*f", as.integer(d), x + 1e-9)   # halves round up
fix_site <- function(x) { x <- trimws(x); ifelse(x %in% names(raw_site_map), raw_site_map[x], x) }
reef_sites <- unique(env$site)

# Nutrients: one row per water sample
nut <- read.csv(nutrient_file, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(site = fix_site(site)) %>%
  filter(site %in% reef_sites) %>%
  transmute(site, depth, replicate, PO4, NO3NO2 = `NO3.NO2`, NH4, DIN = NH4 + `NO3.NO2`)

# CTD: all readings between ctd_depth[1] and ctd_depth[2] m
ctd <- read.csv(ctd_file, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(site = fix_site(site)) %>%
  filter(site %in% reef_sites, depth >= ctd_depth[1], depth <= ctd_depth[2]) %>%
  transmute(site, temperature = `Temperature.CTD`, salinity = Salinity, chla = `Chl-a`)

stopifnot("Not every site is in the nutrient file" = all(reef_sites %in% nut$site),
          "Not every site is in the CTD file"      = all(reef_sites %in% ctd$site))

# Mean, min, max and n per site and variable
site_stats <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(-any_of(c("site", "depth", "replicate")), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(site, variable) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop")
}
stats <- bind_rows(site_stats(ctd), site_stats(nut))

# Site values in the metadata (used in all models)
meta_values <- env %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(table1_vars$column), first), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-site, names_to = "column", values_to = "metadata") %>%
  left_join(select(table1_vars, variable, column), by = "column")

# Formatted Table 1: "metadata value (raw min–max)", sites by increasing DIN
din_order <- meta_values %>% filter(variable == "DIN") %>% arrange(metadata) %>% pull(site)
n_samples <- dplyr::count(nut, site, name = "Water samples")
table1 <- stats %>%
  left_join(select(meta_values, site, variable, metadata), by = c("site", "variable")) %>%
  left_join(select(table1_vars, variable, label, digits), by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0(fmt(metadata, digits), " (", fmt(min, digits), "–", fmt(max, digits), ")")) %>%
  select(site, label, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = cell) %>%
  left_join(n_samples, by = "site") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = din_order)) %>%
  arrange(site) %>%
  mutate(Site = unname(site_labels[as.character(site)])) %>%
  select(Site, `Water samples`, all_of(table1_vars$label))
table1
save_tab(table1, "T3_table1_environment_per_site")

# Raw means vs the site values in the metadata (used in all models)
raw_vs_meta <- stats %>%
  left_join(meta_values, by = c("site", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(rel_diff = abs(mean - metadata) / abs(metadata),
         differs  = rel_diff > 0.05) %>%
  select(site, variable, raw_mean = mean, metadata, rel_diff, differs, n) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
filter(raw_vs_meta, differs)   # site values that do not match the raw measurements
if (any(raw_vs_meta$differs))
  warning("Some metadata site values (used in the models) differ from the mean of the raw measurements: see T6")
save_tab(raw_vs_meta, "T6_raw_vs_metadata")
beep(2)
```
